name: CHROMATIC RUIN: The Augmentation War
description: A physical hex-grid board game where BCI or goggle users see a second layer of augmentation trees, hidden trap cards, and animated chrome-soldiers marching across the board. Physical pieces represent base-tier units, but the AR layer reveals upgrade paths, corporate sponsorships, and sabotage events invisible to unaugmented players. The asymmetry between augmented and unaugmented play is considered either a feature or a scandal depending on who you ask.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 player discovers their BCI is feeding their game strategies to a corponation's real-world logistics AI.
An unaugmented the Gray Zone hustler consistently beats augmented opponents, drawing corporate attention and dangerous scrutiny.
The AR layer begins showing messages no one programmed — coordinates, names, warnings — during a high-stakes tournament.
